request.text: The Shadow Circle learned to bend the shard's light into spells. The Illagers learned from them, and learned the wrong lessons. Their mansions in the dark woods are copies of our halls, built by people who wanted the shard's power without its burden. The burden is the point. Carry it.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Male, 55-65. Excellent quality. Persona: the last master of a secret order of spellcasters who learned to bend an ancient light into magic and saw others learn the wrong lessons. Emotion: grave, stern, solemn, quietly scornful, commanding. A deep, resonant, dark voice, slow and deliberate, almost like an incantation; it never rises, and it does not ask twice.
